title: Fenton Unit Reviewer
description: Multi-agent Fenton mining, step 8 (revised 2026-10-09, pure LLM, no scripts): an independent body reviews every numeric triple in 06_schema.json for unit whitelist compliance, conversion correctness, and missing units, returning only a revision list (before/after/reason) and never rewriting raw. The main agent writes 06c_unit_review.json and runs the correction loop back to the filler. The canonical unit table and whitelist are inlined in system.md.
